title: Kya Super Kool Hai Hum
desc: A comedy film that tells the story of two friends, who dream of becoming successful actors. They get caught up in a series of misadventures when they try to impress two women and end up in hilarious situations. The movie features humor, witty one-liners, and a fast-paced storyline.

title: Sunday
desc: Voice actress Sehar wakes with a hangover to find she’s lost an entire day. As she retraces Sunday’s events, she becomes the prime suspect in a murder, chased by a gangster and an unhinged cabbie, Ballu.

title: Raja Ki Aayegi Baaraat
desc: Raja rapes Mala and the court orders him to marry her. His family continues to torture Mala and attempts to kill her, but she manages to win over Raja and his family with her good deeds.

title: Mission Istanbul
desc: An action thriller film that follows the story of a journalist, Vikas, who is sent to Istanbul to cover a breaking news story. However, he becomes embroiled in a dangerous conspiracy involving international terrorism and political corruption. The movie features high-octane action sequences and explores themes of courage, patriotism, and the importance of journalistic integrity in a thrilling and suspenseful plot.
